newsitem.title: USA: United Stationers Q1 net up on cost cuts.
newsitem.headline: United Stationers Q1 net up on cost cuts.

text.p: United Stationers Inc said Thursday a lower overall cost structure in the wake of a merger with Lagasse helped earnings rise in the first quarter ended March 31.

The company said net income reached $10.0 million, or $0.65 per fully diluted share, versus $8.2 million, or $0.51. Net income attributable to common stockholders rose to $9.6 million from $7.8 million last year.
Sales in the period rose to $635.0 million from $586.9 million in the first quarter last year, the company said.
United Stationers said it believes there is still room to improve its expense ratio through improved efficiencies.
The company sells business products to resellers.
Its shares closed off 3/8 Thursday at 20-1/8.
